notes: Article labelled ORIGINAL RESEARCH (p. 1); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. Carbon sorbent: pristine ZTC (templated carbon, measured 2.38 wt% at 77 K, 1 bar, BET 3,206 m2/g); also PIM-1/80 wt% ZTC composite. MOF (UiO-66) and PIM-1 polymer samples are not carbon sorbents. H2 uptake measured on Micromeritics ASAP 2020 HD (volumetric instrument; the paper does not use the word 'volumetric'). Table 2 literature values are quoted from other work; this paper's own values are in Table 1 and Figure 6. No statement that all H2 values were published before; the paper says the ZTC composites 'had not been reported before' (p. 8, Conclusion). No supplementary file supplied.
